title: cpictl test case
description: A test case of a deployed integration flow: .cpi/tests/<FlowId>/<case>.yaml, run with cpictl test run or the MCP tool run_tests. See docs/testing.md (Test runs).

flow.description: Integration flow ID; default the folder name.

tags.description: Tags to select cases (--tag, MCP tags).

order.description: Sorts the cases of a flow (lower first, then by file name).

stringOrList.description: A string or a list of strings.

duration.description: A duration such as 60s, 2m or 1m30s, or a number of seconds.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers (not Authorization, Cookie, X-CSRF-Token, Host, Content-Length).

body_file.description: File with the body, relative to the case file.

url.description: Endpoint URL (or a URL below it); only when the flow has several endpoints.

path.description: Sub-path and query below the flow's endpoint, for senders that route on the path.

process_direct_address.description: ProcessDirect address: the message goes through the test harness flow.

idoc.description: IDoc XML for the flow's IDoc sender (with EDI_DC40 control record).

idoc_file.description: File with the IDoc XML, relative to the case file.

odata.description: OData V2 request to the flow's OData sender.

method.description: GET (default), POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.

entity_set.description: Entity set, or $metadata; empty: the service document.

key.description: Entity key as written in the parentheses, e.g. '4711'.

wait.description: How long to wait for the message processing log, default 60s.

expect.description: The expected outcome; every expectation that is set must hold. Without http_status and error_contains the HTTP status must be 2xx, unless message_status expects a failure (FAILED, ESCALATED, ...).

http_status.description: HTTP status of the endpoint's answer.

message_status.description: Final status of the message: COMPLETED, FAILED, ESCALATED, ... (empty: not checked).

response_not_contains.description: Texts the response does not contain.

response_xpath.description: Path (/a/b, //name, [@attr='v'], /@attr, /text()) -> expected text of the first match.

response_json.description: Dotted path (a.b.0.c) -> expected value (numbers by value, objects and arrays as JSON).

error_contains.description: Texts expected in the error: the log's error text or the response of a failed call.

custom_headers.description: Custom header properties expected in the message processing log.

steps_include.description: Step names or model step IDs that appear in the message's steps.

max_duration.description: Longest processing time (the message log, else the HTTP call).

stub_calls.description: Requests the receiver stub (CPICTL_Test_Stub) must have recorded since the case started. Cases with stub_calls run alone.

header.description: Headers (name in any case) with these values.

count.description: Number of matching calls, default 1 (0: none).
